evidence.name: Screen field: How long this slide shows
evidence.userNeed: Know what "How long this slide shows" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: How long this slide shows
sections.description: A two-thumb slider that sets the window, as a share of the carousel's total duration, during which this slide is on screen. Drag the thumbs apart to give this slide a longer share, which leaves less time for the others. For example, a 25% window at a 20-second total keeps this slide visible about 5 seconds; keep slides spread evenly and only widen the most persuasive one.
